title: CDKPredict machine-learning model stratifies risk on first-line CDK4/6 inhibitors
summary: CDKPredict is an interpretable machine-learning model using clinicopathologic and genomic features to predict outcomes of first-line CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy in metastatic breast cancer. Trained on 1,264 patients, it reached a time-dependent AUC of 0.74 in an external cohort (n=564) and split patients into low, intermediate and high risk with median progression-free survival of 29.8, 14.7 and 8.0 months (hazard ratio 3.85 high versus low). A reduced CDKPredict-S was validated in two external cohorts totaling 1,019 patients. The work is retrospective and prospective evaluation is pending.
ai_technology: Interpretable machine-learning model on clinicopathologic and genomic features

evidence.unknown: Whether risk-adapted treatment improves outcomes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The model predicted progression risk from baseline features.
